purpose: Separate Harmony CLI/SDK substrate assets from the future Rust Harmony atomic-operation service that must be published with AgentLab.

currentAssets.role: Existing Harmony CLI/SDK substrate with hvigorw, ohpm, and hdc smoke paths. Historical filename mentions web2atomic but this is not the Rust ops service.
Machine-readable pointer to asrelease source refs and future AgentLab release policy for Rust Harmony ops.

plannedPayloads.scope: Basic Harmony project/build atoms before Web2Atomic integration.
Device/emulator/deploy/launch/probe atoms after P0 is stable.
Upper pipeline that consumes alharmony ops; not the base project/build layer.

offlineClosurePolicy.includeHarmonySdk: already covered through Harmony/vol-harmony assets where applicable
offlineClosurePolicy.gate: Built executable payload plus exact bytes, SHA256, smoke evidence, and non-destructive install-plan/readiness check.
